For the matrix
$F=[\begin{aligned}8 & 1 & -2 \\ 3 & v & 4 \\ 5 & 6 & 7\end{aligned}],$
find the minor ${M}_{13}$ of the element ${f}_{13}.$

${M}_{13}=${{field-1}}
feedback.worked_solution:
To evaluate the minor of ${f}_{13},$ we remove the first row and third column: 

$$
F=[\begin{aligned}∗ & ∗ & -2 \\ 3 & v & ∗ \\ 5 & 6 & ∗\end{aligned}]
$$

So, the minor of ${f}_{13}$ is

$$
\begin{aligned}{M}_{13} & =det[\begin{aligned}3 & v \\ 5 & 6\end{aligned}] \\  & =|\begin{aligned}3 & v \\ 5 & 6\end{aligned}| \\  & =3\cdot 6-v\cdot 5 \\  & =18-5v\end{aligned}
$$
